extracted text: The paper describes the development of dilute Al-Sc-Zr alloys and their composites with Saffil short alumina fibers. Two main alloys were studied: Alloy 1 (Al-0.09Sc-0.045Zr at.%) and Alloy 2 (Al-0.06Sc-0.03Zr at.%). These alloys were produced by melting 99.99% pure Al with Al-2Sc and Al-1.6Zr wt.% master alloys at 800°C. The alloys were then subjected to different cooling rates and aging treatments. A two-step aging treatment (300°C for 4h followed by 425°C for 8h) was found to be optimal for precipitation strengthening. For the Al-MMC composites, Saffil fibers (>96 vol.% Al₂O₃) were used at volume fractions of 0%, 4%, and 15%. Saffil contains a small amount of silica (<4 vol.%). The paper also compares these alloys with commercial armor alloys AA5083-H131 and AA6061-T6, as well as Al-2Cu wt.% alloy composites.

abbreviations.Saffil: Commercial name for high-purity crystalline alumina fibers
abbreviations.DCP-OES/DCP-AES: Direct Coupled Plasma-Optical Emission Spectroscopy/Atomic Emission Spectroscopy
